subject.title: Discord account-to-agent routing falls back to default agent instead of matching by account name

question: Should Discord multi-account routing add a guarded same-name accountId-to-agent fallback after explicit binding tiers miss, or should explicit bindings remain the only supported contract?
rationale: The source-level gap is clear, but the choice changes permission-sensitive fallback semantics across session, model/provider, and channel routing boundaries.

options.title: Approve guarded fallback
options.body: Route non-default Discord accountIds to an existing same-named configured agent only after explicit binding tiers miss, with distinct diagnostics, docs, tests, and live Discord proof.

options.title: Keep explicit bindings only
options.body: Leave runtime routing unchanged and add clearer doctor/status/docs warnings for Discord accounts that appear intended to bind to same-named agents.

options.title: Repair the fork fix first
options.body: Use the linked fork PR only as source material after resolving conflicts, adding a configured-agent guard, and supplying real Discord proof.

recommendation.title: Approve guarded fallback
recommendation.body: Route non-default Discord accountIds to an existing same-named configured agent only after explicit binding tiers miss, with distinct diagnostics, docs, tests, and live Discord proof.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest feature-history signal on multi-agent routing and recent shared routing maintenance.
